context.handoff: ASTC is durably promoted to company PSTC when the next role is admitted. CEO all-hands briefs accompany subsequent role prompts. These are transactional audit records, not signed contracts.

training: independent task and general regression checks
approval_gates.global_promotion: Repeated approval creates a candidate only; explicit owner review is always required before cross-company promotion.
approval_gates.legal: Model output is issue spotting and evidence collection, not legal advice or a finding of compliance. Qualified human review is required where applicable.
